text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the Derby was Winning 
Ticket. Biwa Hayahide feels terror toward 
her ability to defy all logic and theory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many calculations are made 
before the challenge, Narita Taishin and 
Winning Ticket surpass all expectations 
with an elusive, mysterious "something."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then let us incorporate that "something" 
into the equation as well. A reckless 
attempt made without even knowing its true 
nature. From that, Biwa Hayahide 
formulates a hypothesis.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing she lacked the "resolve to grow 
stronger," Biwa Hayahide requested 
high-intensity training once more, 
determined never to lose in her next goal, 
the Kikuka Sho.
